name: Calligraphy
description: Calligraphy word search puzzles gather pen and ink English for adults and seniors — nib, flourish, baseline, script, italic and quiet desk words — without pen-maker or ink brands. Play free online with easy, medium, hard and large print. No account and no timer: just the calm vocabulary of practice sheets and evening lettering. Short tools such as pen, ink and line keep beginners moving; longer anchors like flourish, ascender and minuscule steady harder boards. It sits under Painting and pairs well with Journaling when you want a wider desk-craft hour. Large print suits soft lamp light. No IP characters — only ordinary lettering English.
